name: Hashima Izumi
source:
Hobbies: Otome game series "Little Love Rhapsody" (Secret: Watching soccer games (This is due to her past hobbies from elementary school))

Izumi is a student in class 3-A of Honoda Junior High School and two years younger than [url=/c36124]Tomoya[/url]. She is an otaku and a member of the doujin circle "Fancy Wave" (ファンシーウェーブ). It was through Tomoya's influence that she became interested in otaku culture, and she is deeply grateful to him for this. She has loved Little Love Rhapsody, an otome video game series released by Sonar for the PlayStation Portable, since Tomoya bought her Little Love Rhapsody 2 and a PlayStation Portable console on her birthday. Following her parents' re-location, she moved to Nagoya but never stopped being an otaku. There is rivalry between [url=/c25934]Eriri[/url] and Izumi, then Izumi decided to compete with Eriri in the next Winter Comiket. Izumi made up her mind to be the illustrator for her brother Iori's doujin circle "Rouge en rouge".

(Source: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saekano:_How_to_Raise_a_Boring_Girlfriend]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.saekano.com/character/]Saekano Offical Site[/url])
